about:
I'm **Yash Kumar Singh**, a B.Tech student at **Delhi Technological University** with a deep passion for **software engineering** and **systems programming**.

I build performant backend systems, from a **Mini Redis server in C++** with O(1) LRU caching to **full-stack banking ledgers** with the MERN stack. I'm also the **Team Manager – Avionics & Software** at **Rocketry DTU**, where I lead flight computer, telemetry, and ground-station development — earning an **"Excellent" grade at the IN-SPACe & ISRO Rocketry Competition (2025)**.

With **1850+ LeetCode rating (Knight Badge)** and **800+ DSA problems** solved, I thrive on algorithmic challenges. When I'm not coding, you'll find me mentoring students, exploring stock-market analysis, or tinkering with embedded systems.

I'm always open to collaborating on interesting projects and learning new technologies!
